obligations.title: Behaviour module and conformance vectors
obligations.description: Implement every Tightbeam.Harness callback and supply every standardized conformance vector or an explicit named-divergence unsupported vector.

obligations.title: Registry entry
obligations.description: Add exactly one Harness.all/0 registry entry and no other harness dispatch in Elixir.

obligations.title: ACP adapter and patches
obligations.description: Vendor or identify the ACP adapter and keep pinned-version patch anchors for every required carrier missing from its wire.

obligations.title: Catalog source and bootstrap
obligations.description: Supply a provider-stamped catalog source, its readiness bootstrap, and its doctor or preflight check.

obligations.title: Capability matrix and skill mirror
obligations.description: Record every capability as parity or a named, negative-tested divergence and update the shipped tightbeam-harnesses skill in the same change.

obligations.title: Provisioned smoke leg
obligations.description: Join the registry-driven smoke matrix with credential, catalog, model, and timing provisioning.

obligations.title: Shared conformance suite
obligations.description: Pass the single branch-free parameterized suite for every registered harness and the permanent fixture harness.

prepare_launch.oracle: rendered plan env, argv, and serialized command equal the vector's expected form

ensure_adapter.oracle: local absence refusal, remote install contribution string, patched fake-bundle bytes, and preserved bundle mode equal the vector's expected form

session_config.oracle: exact _meta map equals the vector's expected map

reconcile_home.oracle: observed write-set equals the expected write-set and sentinels outside it remain byte-identical

materialize_skills.oracle: cwd entries under the reserved namespace equal the expected entries

credential_ready?/harvest_credential.oracle: credential readiness boolean and harvested bytes equal the vector's expected values

probe_cli.oracle: pinned CLI version and path decision equal the vector's expected values

containment_additions.oracle: exact grant list equals the vector's expected list

classify_auth_event.oracle: exact classification equals the expected classification; a missing positive envelope is an explicit named-divergence unsupported case

classify_subagent_event.oracle: exact classification equals the expected classification; a missing positive envelope is an explicit named-divergence unsupported case

fetch_catalog.oracle: provider-stamped entries or the exact source error equal the vector's expected result

wire_projection.oracle: decoded fields round-trip the manifest field list exactly
